source:
## Semantics: E2 (recovery — R2 declared resync, deterministic spans)
grammar RecoveryResync version "1.0.0" mode "v1" {
  ## key = value ; pairs. Recovery for document skips deterministic
  ## junk: any run of non-";" bytes ending at a ";" (the author owns
  ## the spans — no trial scanning).
  pair = ( 1*( %x61-7A / %x30-39 ) ) as k "=" ( 1*( %x30-39 ) ) as v ";"
  document = 1*( pair )
  resync document = 1*( %x00-3A / %x3C-FF ) ";"
  entry main: document

  test main {
    accept "a=1;b=2;"
    reject "a=1;b=2;@@junk@@;c=3;d=4;"
  }
}
